question: Does Cockroach Continuum still offer the $15/month (50M RU + 10 GiB) Basic allowance to new organizations created on or after 2026-09-15, and on what identity terms?
why: The pricing page states the Continuum pricing applies from 2026-09-15 and that no credit card is required to create an org, but the $15/50M RU/10 GiB allowance is documented on the Basic plan page and its applicability to new Continuum orgs was not confirmed.
